SELECT gt.*, a.area_name AS area_name, os.name AS operation_status_name, u.user_name AS manager_name, COALESCE(string_agg(DISTINCT e.name, ','), '') AS equipments_name_str FROM garbage_transfer gt LEFT JOIN sys_area a ON gt.area_code = a.area_code AND a.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_operation_status os ON gt.operation_status_id = os.sys_operation_status_id AND os.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON gt.manager_id = u.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_equipment e ON e.sys_equipment_id::TEXT = ANY ( ARRAY(SELECT json_array_elements_text(gt.equipment_ids::json)::TEXT) ) AND e.deleted = 0
GROUP BY gt.id, a.area_name, os.name, u.user_name ORDER BY gt.id DESC LIMIT #{reqVO.pageSize} OFFSET #{reqVO.offset}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT gt.id) FROM garbage_transfer gt
